notes: Corrected: the supplied subject *anything* (t014) moves from ἀπόκρυφον to ἐγένετο. Rule 68 opens by scoping itself to a verbless clause's supplied copula and subject, and this clause expresses its verb, so rule 9 governs and the predicate keeps only its own word.
The negation *nothing* stays whole on οὐ: no negative indefinite token stands in the Greek for rules 41 and 59 to hand it to.
